name: return-stmt-negative-test-c1f15d4b97/missing-return-forkjoin-1-e.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: supported statement list includes Local variable declarations and Return, but does not include fork statements or named worker declarations.

## Expressions: "[Start action](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#start-action)" and "[Wait action](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#wait-action)" are listed; fork and named workers are not listed.
reason: The case asserts missing-return errors both in an int-returning named worker inside a fork and in the enclosing tuple-returning function. Fork statements and named workers are essential to the worker-return assertion and are absent from the subset's positive support lists. Support for start and wait actions does not cover fork workers.
unsupported_constructs: named worker declarations, including a worker with an explicit return type
test_design_notes: Negative missing-return checks remain in scope for supported constructs, but the worker-specific assertion depends on unsupported constructs.
